## Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools

## Powering Productivity with In-App Intelligence

## More Creative Options and Formats

• Apple Creator Studio updates will be available on the App Store this November for free for existing subscribers. New subscribers pay $12.99 (U.S.) per month or $129 (U.S.) per year. All new subscribers will enjoy a one-month free trial of Apple Creator Studio, and with the purchase of a new Mac or qualifying iPad, customers can receive three months of Apple Creator Studio for free. 5

• Education savings are available for college students and educators for $2.99 (U.S.) per month or $29.99 (U.S.) per year. 6

• Apple Creator Studio is available to download on the App Store as a universal purchase.

• Up to six family members can share all of the apps and content included in Apple Creator Studio with Family Sharing.

• One-time-purchase versions of Final Cut Pro ( $299.99 U.S.), Logic Pro ( $199.99 U.S.), Pixelmator Pro ( $49.99 U.S.), Motion ( $49.99 U.S.), Compressor ( $49.99 U.S.), and MainStage ( $29.99 U.S.) are available on the Mac App Store. 7

• Free versions of Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform continue to be available and are included with every new iPhone, Mac, and iPad.

## Media

• Text of this article October 27, 2026 PRESS RELEASE Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools Updates bring built-in MotionVFX content to Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools to Logic Pro, and new intelligence features to Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced transformative updates to Apple Creator Studio , the powerful collection of creative apps designed to put studio-grade tools into the hands of modern creators across Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Final Cut Pro for Mac now includes built-in MotionVFX — an expansive collection of visual effects, plug-ins, transitions, templates, and motion graphics tools — as well as seamless editing in Pixelmator Pro. Apple’s curated Content Hub now includes video assets and is available in Final Cut Pro. Music creators using Logic Pro for Mac gain a new intelligent assistant in beta, 1 an enhanced Stem Splitter that now separates drums, and a redesigned Browser that incorporates all sounds, with music understanding and even a Splice library. Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, which lets creators transform selected areas of an image using natural language. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers introduce new AI features in beta, including assistants 2 that understand document context and new Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for workflow automation. 3 They also add stock video in the Content Hub and new premium themes and templates. Apple Creator Studio updates will be available on the App Store this November as a free update for existing subscribers. 4 “This is our most exciting update since the launch of Apple Creator Studio. • Free versions of Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform continue to be available and are included with every new iPhone, Mac, and iPad.

• The assistant (beta) in Logic Pro for Mac requires macOS 27 Golden Gate or later on an Apple Intelligence-capable Mac and is available in U.S. English only.

• The assistant (beta) in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers requires an Apple Intelligence-capable device running iOS 27, iPadOS 27, or macOS 27 or later, and is available in U.S. English only.

• Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers requires macOS 27 or later.

• The Apple Creator Studio version of Final Cut Pro for Mac requires macOS 26.6 or later and a Mac with Intel or Apple silicon (some features require Apple silicon). Final Cut Pro for iPad requires iPadOS 26.6 or later and an iPad with an A16, A17 Pro, or M1 chip or later. Final Cut Camera requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 26.6 or iPadOS 26.6 or later. Logic Pro for Mac requires macOS 26.1 or later and a Mac with Apple silicon. Logic Pro for iPad requires iPadOS 26 or later and an iPad with an Apple A12 Bionic chip or later. Pixelmator Pro requires macOS 26 or later for Mac (Intel or Apple silicon; some features require Apple silicon) and iPadOS 26 or later for iPad (A16, A17 Pro, or M1 chip or later). Motion requires macOS 15.6 or later. Compressor requires macOS 15.6 or later and a Mac with Intel or Apple silicon (Apple Immersive Video processing requires 32GB of RAM, with 64GB and storage read speeds of 2,000MB/s or faster recommended; some features require Apple silicon). Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform require macOS 26, iOS 26, or iPadOS 26 or later.

• Available to new and qualified returning subscribers who purchase a new Mac or qualifying iPad from Apple or an Apple Authorized Reseller. iPad must have at least 6GB of memory and an A16, A17 Pro, or M-series chip or later.
